description:
You are a sales director using Odoo CRM. You frequently need to review high-value opportunities in your pipeline, but manually re-applying filters every time is tedious.

Your task: Create a saved favorite filter in the CRM Pipeline view with these specifications:

1. Navigate to the CRM Pipeline (Opportunities) view
2. Add a filter condition: Expected Revenue >= 50,000 (use the search bar's Filters menu to add a custom filter)
3. Save this filtered view as a Favorite with the exact name: High Value Deals

The filter should appear under the 'Favorites' section in the search bar dropdown so you can quickly re-apply it in future sessions.

Note: You are already logged in as admin. The CRM Pipeline should be visible in your browser.
